panel.title: Windows Security i Sysmon – ostatnie 24 godziny według czasu indeksowania

search.query: index=main host=$lab_host|s$ _index_earliest=-24h _index_latest=now | eval source_name=lower(source), source_type=lower(sourcetype) | eval channel=case( in(source_name, "wineventlog:security", "xmlwineventlog:security") OR in(source_type, "wineventlog:security", "xmlwineventlog:security"), "Windows Security", in(source_name, "wineventlog:microsoft-windows-sysmon/operational", "xmlwineventlog:microsoft-windows-sysmon/operational") OR in(source_type, "wineventlog:microsoft-windows-sysmon/operational", "xmlwineventlog:microsoft-windows-sysmon/operational"), "Sysmon") | where isnotnull(channel) | stats count AS events max(_indextime) AS last_ingested max(_time) AS last_event by channel | append [ | makeresults count=2 | streamstats count AS row | eval channel=if(row=1, "Windows Security", "Sysmon"), events=0 | fields channel events ] | stats sum(events) AS events_24h max(last_ingested) AS last_ingested max(last_event) AS last_event by channel | eval ingest_age_min=round((now()-last_ingested)/60, 1) | eval status=case( events_24h=0, "BRAK DANYCH", now()-last_ingested>=1800, "CISZA", now()-last_event>=1800, "STARE ZDARZENIA", true(), "AKTYWNE") | fieldformat last_ingested=strftime(last_ingested, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | fieldformat last_event=strftime(last_event, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | table channel status events_24h last_ingested last_event ingest_age_min | sort channel
